mechanic: Original embedded phone/laptop geometry and hardware textures, planar screen UVs, six-act device/camera motion, six glass lens shapes, studio environment and paired 360-degree turntable.
changes: Two verified local screen images replace source demo HTML, app icons and claims. Approved palette and native typography/captions are retained. Absolute sampling preserves forward source motion independently of seek direction; tiny idle device drift is omitted. The original 34-degree lens is retained; actual mesh bounds drive a smooth paired-reveal camera dolly and per-pose closing fit in all formats. Shared local Three.js owns resources; no loaders, remote decoders or runtime network are added. Shared screen/model helpers also serve the two glass styles. Before both devices arrive, the closing dolly uses the first complete paired pose; subsequent framing uses actual closing poses.
qualification: Four-format native compiler/browser gates pass, including 16 viewport checks, 372 event samples, exact reverse pixels, camera/geometry/screen/caption checks and four negative cases. Source forward parity compares 22525 state values at 901 instants, with maximum visual arithmetic error about 1e-6. Original overlapping laptop tweens are direction-dependent; native sampling intentionally fixes that behavior. Cumulative workflow, seams, audio and encoded exports remain pending. Exact event-crossing regression passes four formats, 16 viewports and 372 samples after the handoff repair; native-rig tests retain the original fit bound and confirm continuity at 11 and 12.5 seconds.
